The plate held about two cannelloni, roughly 250 g in total, with a baked pasta tube filled with ricotta/spinach or meat, plus tomato sauce and cheese. Cannelloni runs about 150-180 kcal per 100 g, so the full portion is around 400 kcal. The second photo shows only a small smear of sauce left on the plate, so almost all of it was eaten. I estimated about 235 g eaten, which gives about 390 kcal.
